alt: 手作市集的攤桌擺著木雕、竹籃、陶壺、布偶、紙風車、串珠與陶哨，居民正在挑看各種不同作品。
scene_prompt: A lively original community craft market displays a richly varied assortment of handmade goods at eye level: carved wooden animals, woven baskets, ceramic teapots, cloth puppets, paper windmills, bead necklaces and clay whistles. Several friendly adult makers show their distinctly different creations while curious families compare them. Make every category visibly different in material, form and purpose; organized abundance rather than identical repeated items. No price tags, no letters or numerals.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, Prefer modern everyday settings and original people in present-day casual clothes, except when the specific scene below calls for historical clothing or nature. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
